input: Research NVIDIA (nvidia.com) for a hedge fund

catalysts.claim: NVIDIA's Q3 FY2027 financial-results release and earnings call are confirmed for November 17, 2026 after the close; the call is scheduled for 5:00 p.m. ET / 2:00 p.m. PT.

The November 17 report is the first scheduled readout on NVIDIA's Q3 guide of $108.0 billion revenue plus or minus 2%, 74.0% gross margin plus or minus 50 basis points, and no assumed Data Center compute revenue from China.

results_vs_guidance.claim: Q2 FY2027 revenue was $96.221 billion versus NVIDIA's Q1-issued Q2 midpoint guide of $91.0 billion and above the $92.82 billion high end; GAAP gross margin was 75.0% versus 74.9% midpoint guidance, and GAAP/non-GAAP operating expenses were $8.408/$8.232 billion versus $8.5/$8.3 billion guidance.

Against consensus, Q2 FY2027 non-GAAP EPS was $2.22 versus $2.09 estimate and revenue was $96.221 billion versus $92.111 billion estimate; the next-quarter consensus shown was $2.47461 EPS and $109.007 billion revenue.

Current company guidance is Q3 FY2027 revenue of $108.0 billion plus or minus 2%, GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin of 74.0% plus or minus 50 basis points, and GAAP/non-GAAP operating expenses of approximately $9.2/$9.0 billion; NVIDIA assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China.

event_driven.claim: On November 8, NVIDIA's board initiated an independent investigation after reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang had been the target of a foreign-intelligence effort; an independent-director committee with outside counsel will oversee it, while the board said it had no reason to believe national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised.

NVIDIA announced memorandums of understanding with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent compute-financing platforms intended to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital; the partnerships remain subject to final agreements.
NVIDIA returned approximately $26.0 billion to shareholders in Q2 FY2027 and had approximately $99.0 billion remaining under its share-repurchase authorization at quarter-end.

credit_signals.claim: As of July 26, 2026, NVIDIA had $22.443 billion of cash and cash equivalents plus $34.143 billion of marketable debt securities, against $1.000 billion of short-term debt and $32.366 billion of long-term debt.

Debt maturities disclosed as of July 26, 2026 included $1.0 billion due in 2026, $4.75 billion in 2028, $3.5 billion in 2029, $2.75 billion in 2030, and $5.25 billion in 2031; NVIDIA issued an aggregate $25.0 billion of senior unsecured notes in June 2026.
NVIDIA said it complied with the required covenants under its outstanding notes as of July 26, 2026, and its $25.0 billion commercial-paper program had no amounts outstanding.
NVIDIA's supply and capacity commitments rose from $119 billion in the prior quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026, with $92 billion scheduled for the remainder of fiscal 2027.

alternative_signals.claim: NVIDIA said Vera Rubin was in full production, with racks running at CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius; it also said Groq 3 LPX was in full production.

Q2 FY2027 Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion, up 18% sequentially and 117% year over year, while the company said customer advances included in the balance sheet increased to $2.8 billion from $160 million at January 25, 2026.

NVIDIA disclosed $105 billion of guarantees for an OpenAI-related SB Energy land, power and shell buildout covering approximately 4.25 gigawatts of IT load, with the first of nine phases expected in fiscal 2029; total disclosed guarantee exposure was $108.5 billion.

insider_and_ownership.claim: Director Mark A. Stevens reported open-market sales of 1,366,000 NVIDIA shares on September 18, 2026 for approximately $300.1 million; the filing showed 27,532,893 shares remaining afterward.

CFO Colette M. Kress reported an open-market sale of 34,918 shares on September 17, 2026 for approximately $7.65 million, and General Counsel Timothy S. Teter reported an open-market sale of 30,460 shares on September 21, 2026 for approximately $6.79 million.
Director Tench Coxe reported a 500,000-share gift or inheritance disposition on November 4, 2026; it was not classified as an open-market sale.

The latest standing ownership records showed Jensen Huang with 909,574,838 shares, or 3.774% of shares outstanding, based primarily on September 16, 2026 filings; Tench Coxe was shown with 52,752,578 shares, or 0.219%, based on November 4 filings.

risks.claim: NVIDIA said its Q3 FY2027 outlook assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China; its 10-Q said that, as of the end of Q2, it was effectively foreclosed from China's data-center-compute market and that H200 shipments under the licensing program were less than 1% of latest-quarter Data Center revenue.

NVIDIA recorded a $0.4 billion H200 excess-inventory and purchase-obligation charge in the first half of fiscal 2027; it said licensed H200 shipments face a 25% U.S. tariff and that it had been unable to pass the tariff to customers.
Five direct customers represented 22%, 14%, 13%, 11% and 10% of accounts receivable as of July 26, 2026, creating customer-concentration and collection exposure even as revenue scales.

NVIDIA's 10-Q disclosed $108.5 billion of maximum gross guarantee exposure, including $105 billion tied to SB Energy guarantees for an OpenAI-related site; the guarantees are triggered by defined tenant defaults and depend on customer and partner performance.

The board's November 8 independent investigation into reporting that Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign-intelligence effort is an unresolved governance and key-person overhang, notwithstanding the board's statement that it had no reason to believe secrets were compromised.

output.research_view: The immediate trading catalyst is the confirmed November 17 report: Q2 materially beat both NVIDIA's own guide and consensus, but the Q3 revenue midpoint is below the latest consensus and gross-margin guidance steps down to 74.0%. The bull case rests on Rubin production, unusually large supply commitments and financing-enabled demand; the main thesis breakers are China/export-control erosion, concentration and guarantee risk, and the still-open board investigation. Sources: [NVIDIA Q2 release](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027), [NVIDIA 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000075/nvda-20260726.htm), [NVIDIA board statement](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors).
